title: Hermes, Antinoos fra Belvedere
institution: Statens Museum for Kunst, National Gallery of Denmark
processing: Museum cast scan; display plinth and foot extremities removed, fracture capped, decimated to 99,999 triangles; deterministic geometric occlusion baked to vertex colors. Exported four units tall before the common 5.0 world scale; fallen orientation and burial are fictional game presentation.
